questions.question: The Sanchi Stupa was discovered by ______ in 1818.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir Henry Taylor**__.

__
 
• **The Sanchi Stupa was discovered by Sir Henry Taylor in 1818**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Sanchi was discovered in the year 1818 by Taylor and an archaeological museum was established in 1919 by Sir John Marshall**.
 
• Great Stupa, the** most noteworthy of the structures at the historic site of Sanchi in Madhya Pradesh state, India**.
 
• It is **one of the oldest Buddhist monuments** in the country and the largest stupa at the site.
 
• Although Buddha never visited the site during any of his former lives or during his earthly existence, the religious nature of this shrine is obvious.
 
 
• The chamber of relics of Stupa 1 contained the remains of Shariputra, a disciple of Shakyamuni who died six months before his master, he is especially venerated by the occupants of the 'small vehicle' or Hinayana.
 
• Having remained a principal centre of Buddhism in medieval India following the spread of Hinduism, Sanchi bears unique witness as a major Buddhist sanctuary to the period from the 3rd century BC to the 1st century AD.

questions.question: Which of the following places is also known as 'Cape Comorin'?

• Kanyakumari is located at the southern tip of the **Cardamom Hills.**

questions.question: The famous Kesavananda Bharati (1973) case was associated with which of the following issues?

options.text: Appointment of the judges of the Supreme Court
Creation of Goa as a State
Abolition of Directive Principles of State Policy

questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Amenability of the Preamble.**__

__
 
• **The famous Kesavananda Bharati (1973) case was associated with Amenability of the Preamble**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kesavananda Bharati Sripadagalvaru and Ors v State of Kerala Case, 1973:
 
 
• Kesavananda Bharati challenged the Kerala land reforms legislation in 1970.
 
• The land reforms case **imposed restrictions on the management of religious property.**
 
• Under Article 26 the case was challenged.
 
 
 
• **The verdict**:
 
 
• Any provision of the Indian Constitution can be amended by the Parliament in order to accomplish its socio-economic obligations that were guaranteed to the citizens as mentioned in the Preamble, provided that such amendment did not change the basic structure of the constitution.
 
• The preamble is a part of the constitution and can be amended by the Parliament under Article 368.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The preamble was not a part of the constitution.
 
 
 
• **The Preamble:**
 
 
• It is a borrowed feature from the **Constitution of the USA.**
 
• The Preamble to the Indian Constitution is based on the **Objectives Resolution **drafted and moved by** Pandit Nehru **and adopted by the Constituent Assembly.
 
• The Preamble has been amended only once, in **1976**, by the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act**, which added three new words **Socialist, Secular, and Integrity**.
 
• The Preamble is **not enforceable in a court of law.**

questions.question: ______ of a country is a systematic statement of all economic transactions of a country with the rest of the world during a specific period typically a year.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Balance of Payment.**__

__
 
• **Balance of Payment of a country is a systematic statement of all economic transactions of a country with the rest of the world during a specific period typically a year**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Balance of Payment(BoP) is the difference between the value of goods exported and the value of goods imported per annum.
 
• **Services are not included in BoP.**
 
• BoP is divided into the** current account and capital account.**
 
 
• Under the current account, transactions are classified into merchandise (exports and imports) and invisible.
 
• The main component of capital account includes foreign investment, loans, and banking capital.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• ​It** **is the rate, at which banks park short-term excess liquidity with the RBI.
 
 
 
• **Gross Primary Deficit**
 
 
• It is a Gross Fiscal Deficit with fewer interest payments.
 
 
 
• **Gross fiscal deficit**
 
 
• It is the excess of total expenditure including loans net of recovery over revenue receipts and non-debt capital receipts.

questions.question: Which gas is used in electrically controlled advertisement signboards so as to enable readability of its contents during the night?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Neon**__.

__
 
• **Neon is used in electrically controlled advertisement signboards so as to enable the readability of its contents during the night**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Working of Neon Lights:**

 
 
• Neon light contains a **small amount of neon gas under low pressure**.
 
• Electricity provides energy to remove electrons away from neon atoms and ionize them.
 
• Ions are attracted to the terminals of the lamp. Hence, completing the electric circuit.
 
• Light is produced when neon atoms gain enough energy to become excited.
 
• When the atom returns to a lower energy state, it releases light.
 
 
 
• **Neon**: 
 
 
• Symbol: Ne
 
• Atomic number: 10
 
• Atomic mass: 20 u
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inert Gases:**

 
 
• They belong to the **18th group of Periodic Table.** For example, He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn.
 
• **Except for Rn**, all inert gases are present in the atmosphere.
 
• **Argon **is used in **Arc. welding and electric bulbs.**
 
• **Helium** is light and non-inflammable so, used in the **balloon, weather indicator**, etc.

questions.question: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas in India is dedicated to _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

__
 
• **Rashtriya Ekta Diwas in India is dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rashtriya Ekta Diwas** is also known as the **National Unity Day**.
 
• It is celebrated on **31 October.**
 
• The day is celebrated to **pay tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and his efforts to form a United India**.
 
• The main objective of shaping the Indian States into sizeable or viable administrative units was sought to be achieved by a threefold process of integration known as the ‘**Patel Scheme**’.
 
 
• **216 states **were merged into respective Provinces, geographically connected to them.
 
• These merged states were included in the territories of the States in** Part B **in the** First Schedule of the Constitution.**
 
• **61 states **were converted into centrally administered areas and were included in** Part C** of the **First Schedule of the Constitution.**
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** was the **first Home Minister of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indira Gandhi's** birth anniversary i.e. **November 19 **is celebrated as **National Integration Day**.

 
 
• It is also known as*** Quami Ekta Divas.***
 
 
 
• **Zakir Hussain **was the third **president of India**.
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee's **birthday i.e** December 25 **is celebrated as **Good Governance Day.**
